notes:
I resolved 84 items: 13 to stations, 66 to places and 5 to none.

Things to check:
1) The unreadable OCR garbles. n1002 'Piva Beeride' and n1450 'hea Head' are almost certainly station names, but I left them as none rather than guess. n1452 'iio' is probably 'do.' (ditto). n294 'Degtiand aries' and n998 'Pentland plises gs)' I resolved to Pentland Skerries, with less confidence than the other variants.
2) Ship positions in 1883 (n11–31, n1422). These are presumably from a whaler's log. n19 (85°89′W) and n27 (69°87′N, east) can't be right as printed. All of them are coded as places.
3) Faroe and Iceland names (Thorshavn, Strómó, Kollefjord, Kalbat, Vaagó, Vaay in Bordo, Gauredal, Tofle, Skykkesholm). The 'faroe' and 'iceland' stations only appear in 1885m/1887m, so I coded all of these as places. Gauredal (Gásadalur) and Tofle (Toftir) are guesses.
4) n881 'N. Uist': I chose North Uist, the island, over Muckle Flugga (N. Unst).
5) n1321 'Whalsey Head': I assigned it to Out Skerries, but it may be a place on Whalsay island.
6) n753 Lerwick (12 observations): check none are really Bressay returns.
7) Places with more than one candidate: Latham Moss (Letham Moss, Stirlingshire, or Lathom, Lancashire), Redcastle (Ross-shire or Angus), Tyne Woods (East Lothian or Northumberland), Garden (Stirlingshire estate), and Sound (?), which the report itself queries.
